propositions: The tickets branch is 1.04 GiB due to the reconciler's .bridge_state cache (92% of size); events are only 55 MB, indicating bookkeeping overhead rather than functional data
Field baseline_advanced_at is written at binding_store.py:375 but read nowhere in src/, causing 1144 entries changed per pass with scattered edits across 18 MB file defeating git delta compression

Marginal cost per bindings.json version is 12.79 KB today; can be reduced to 1.74 KB (7.4x) by deleting baseline_advanced_at timestamp and halved further (12.8x total) by moving last_get_pass rotation bookkeeping out
The .bridge_state cache must remain committed to git because the reconciler runs on ephemeral GitHub-hosted runners and requires durable state

A one-time history rewrite using git fast-export/filter/fast-import reduces 1,172,586,762 to 98,803,422 bytes (8.4%) while preserving all 49,888 commits and 2,661 merges, with HEAD tree byte-identical after dynamic re-add

Rollout requires staged format changes (A1-A5) with mixed-version compatibility, descendant workflow execution gates, epoch-mismatch fail-closed guards, and a verified off-repo backup bundle before reclaim publication
